name: Cenarion Moondust
summary: At the Moonkin Stone east of Auberdine, Cenarion Moondust calls forth Lunaclaw. Night elf druids use the sacred powder in their trial to become Druids of the Claw.

sections.title: A Rite of the Claw
sections.body: Mathrengyl Bearwalker gives Cenarion Moondust to young druids in Darnassus for their final trial of heart and body. To face Lunaclaw, the guardian, an initiate travels to the moonkin dens east of Auberdine in Darkshore. Scattered on the ancient Moonkin Stone, the powder summons Lunaclaw to test the druid in combat. Through the trial, the initiate takes in the enduring strength needed to channel the bear form.

faq.q: What is Cenarion Moondust used for?
faq.answer: Night elf druid initiates scatter Cenarion Moondust on the Moonkin Stone in Darkshore to summon Lunaclaw and prove their strength and resolve in the trial for bear form.

faq.q: Where do I use the Cenarion Moondust?
faq.answer: Scatter the Cenarion Moondust over the Moonkin Stone in a moonkin cave in the hills directly east of Auberdine in Darkshore.
Mathrengyl Bearwalker, a druid trainer at the Cenarion Enclave in Darnassus, gives Cenarion Moondust to initiates ready for the trial of body and heart.

faq.q: What happens if I lose the moondust?
faq.answer: If the moondust is lost or spent in a failed attempt against Lunaclaw, return to Darnassus and ask Mathrengyl Bearwalker to renew the trial.

angles.text: As a night elf druid, using Cenarion Moondust begins the final step toward becoming a Druid of the Claw and mastering bear form.
As a night elf, you encounter the ancient traditions of the Cenarion Circle in the dust, which joins nature worship with lunar ritual to honor Darkshore's beasts.
